import csv
import re
from decimal import Decimal

# Invoice data extracted from PDFs
invoices = {
    '003071': {
        'vendor': 'Grove Office Supply',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Archive cartons, reinforced - batch 3', 'qty': '10', 'unit_price': '12.45', 'amount': '124.50'},
            {'description': 'Labels "Handle with care", roll 3', 'qty': '3', 'unit_price': '11.80', 'amount': '35.40'},
            {'description': 'Cut-to-length protective liner, grade 3', 'qty': '2.5', 'unit_price': '14.76', 'amount': '36.90'},
            {'description': 'Returned labels credit, order 3', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-9.80', 'amount': '-9.80'},
        ],
        'subtotal': '187.00',
        'tax': '23.17',
        'total': '210.17'
    },
    '003082': {
        'vendor': 'Harbor Workshop Ltd',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Bench assembly, series 3', 'qty': '2', 'unit_price': '1279.60', 'amount': '2559.20'},
            {'description': 'Alignment service, station 3', 'qty': '1.5', 'unit_price': '86.40', 'amount': '129.60'},
            {'description': 'Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 3, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', 'qty': '3', 'unit_price': '50.75', 'amount': '152.25'},
            {'description': 'Precision shims, pack 3', 'qty': '7', 'unit_price': '4.375', 'amount': '30.63'},
            {'description': 'Freight and handling, zone 3', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '42.50', 'amount': '42.50'},
            {'description': 'Volume discount, agreement 3', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-37.00', 'amount': '-37.00'},
        ],
        'subtotal': '2877.18',
        'tax': '155.28',
        'total': '3032.46'
    },
    '003093': {
        'vendor': 'Iris Field Services',
        'items': [
            {'description': 'Site survey, area 3', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '471.50', 'amount': '471.50'},
            {'description': 'Travel time, route 3', 'qty': '2.25', 'unit_price': '64.80', 'amount': '145.80'},
            {'description': 'Calibration standard, set 3', 'qty': '2', 'unit_price': '37.25', 'amount': '74.50'},
            {'description': 'Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 3', 'qty': '4', 'unit_price': '18.95', 'amount': '75.80'},
            {'description': 'Cable assemblies, shielded, length 3 m', 'qty': '5', 'unit_price': '11.40', 'amount': '57.00'},
            {'description': 'Previously billed visit credit, ticket 3', 'qty': '1', 'unit_price': '-27.00', 'amount': '-27.00'},
        ],
        'subtotal': '797.60',
        'tax': '91.64',
        'total': '889.25'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        for item in data['items']:
            writer.writerow([
                invoice_id,
                data['vendor'],
                item['description'],
                item['qty'],
                item['unit_price'],
                item['amount']
            ])

# Perform reconciliation
reconciliation = []
for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
    # Calculate sum of line amounts
    computed_subtotal = sum(Decimal(item['amount']) for item in data['items'])
    
    # Get printed values
    printed_subtotal = Decimal(data['subtotal'])
    tax = Decimal(data['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(data['total'])
    
    # Compute total
    computed_total = computed_subtotal + tax
    
    # Calculate difference (computed - printed)
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    # Determine status
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': str(computed_subtotal),
        'tax': str(tax),
        'printed_total': str(printed_total),
        'computed_total': str(computed_total),
        'difference': str(difference),
        'status': status
    })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(reconciliation)

# Report discrepancies
print("Reconciliation Summary:")
print("=" * 80)
for rec in reconciliation:
    print(f"Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: {rec['status'].upper()}")
    print(f"  Subtotal (sum of line items): {rec['subtotal']}")
    print(f"  Tax: {rec['tax']}")
    print(f"  Printed Total: {rec['printed_total']}")
    print(f"  Computed Total: {rec['computed_total']}")
    print(f"  Difference: {rec['difference']}")
    if rec['status'] == 'discrepancy':
        print(f"  *** DISCREPANCY FOUND ***")
    print()
EOF
